name: The Tri-State Tornado
blurb: The longest tornado track ever recorded and the deadliest single tornado in United States history. It pre-dates the national database by twenty-five years, so this track is a reconstruction, not a survey.
source: Reconstructed from the documented sequence of towns struck and the recorded times
caveat: The other tornadoes of 18 March 1925 — in Tennessee, Kentucky and Alabama — are documented as having happened but not with coordinates precise enough to place. They are left out rather than invented, so this day shows one track where the real day had several.
